releaseNotes: Arabic OCR Diagnostic adds a safe one-file test under Settings > Smart Search Index. Pick one PDF or image and Smart Life runs the current local PaddleOCR directly, shows RAW OCR TEXT plus Arabic/Latin/digit counts, and does not clear, rebuild, or rewrite the completed Smart Search index. Existing v0.9.5 Arabic Rescue Search, English/number search, checkpoints, Pause/Resume, Turbo OCR, Connect to PC, reminders, sounds, and prior Smart Life behavior are preserved.
